plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: Map and GameObjectDisplayInfo startup sources and the required liquid material/type sources are mandatory. A missing or mismatched caller key for a mandatory encrypted source is fatal; no partial collision component is published.
source_policy.dependencies: A present WDT whose required ADT is malformed or otherwise fails acquisition, conversion, integrity, resource, or publication checks is fatal; only an explicitly missing WDT is recorded as unknown.
source_policy.failure: A missing WDT has unknown coverage and emits no tree or placement proof. A selected map:<id> whose WDT is missing is rejected without falling back to another map or the all-available-maps selection.

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: Authenticated logical build-70450 CASC collection identity; caller keys do not change source identity
identities.keys: Key names, values, counts, hashes and input paths are excluded from plans, package context, manifests, diagnostic records, logs and errors. The plan binds only provided-salsa20-v1, not key-list contents.

verification.source_authentication: Offline verification checks producer-reported source coverage, not an independent client snapshot.
verification.key_coverage: A public key list or a partial match never proves complete decryption. Only successful full-frame decode and complete content CKey validation for each mandatory selected source establishes decryption of that source.

facts: Map and GameObjectDisplayInfo source availability, declared and available bytes, full-checksum and encoded-key authentication flags, row counts, and section admission states
Liquid material/type source identities, byte counts, first-magic tags, and direct/copy/materialized row counts
Ordered startup rows with display IDs, file IDs, and collision disposition or omission reason
Map topology and per-map WDT/global status; each present WDT map records all 4096 cells with distinct own and parent-replay states
Complete ID-ordered placement proofs for present-WDT maps and size/SHA-256 bindings for every authenticated published VMap artifact

resume: Caller-supplied keys and fresh private scratch are required for every client-side resume. A sealed compatible collision component is replayed with a fresh six-owner scratch namespace before immutable artifact comparison. A complete output refuses writes.

limits.meaning: These are downward-only API budgets. The combined logical ceiling and coverage reservation are enforced before production; capacity headroom is reserved separately. Cap failures never truncate output.

provided_keys.input: explicit regular file, final symlink and special file rejected; read once with metadata identity and extra-byte EOF check
provided_keys.record_format: forever-tact-keys TAB 1 LF; sorted unique lowercase hex16 u64 name TAB hex32 key LF
provided_keys.cipher: Salsa20/20 with 16-byte keys, nonce4/8 padded to8, frame-index little-endian XOR, initial block counter zero
provided_keys.frames: one E wrapper around N or strict Z only; mandatory complete content MD5 and encoded frame MD5 where framed
provided_keys.source_protection: canonical key-file source included in protected roots before output writes

legacy_preservation.v15: Build70450CompatibleCollisionV1; build70450 compatible GNU15-v2; disabled keys
legacy_preservation.supported_clients: 70450 remains absent from generic, native, legacy and default product admission

admission.store: LocalStore::open_db2_70450_with_keys; same exact 70450 bootstrap, budgets and guards as revision 17
admission.collision: Build70450CollisionProvidedKeysV1 selects only the compatible Linux GNU15-v2 collision producer and its leased disk path
admission.platform: Linux only before client/key/output I/O; explicit --keys source
